test_append_series: test appending one polars Series to another and verify resulting values and chunk count
test_append_self: test appending a polars Series to itself and verify doubled values with multiple chunks
test_append_bad_input: test that appending a DataFrame or LazyFrame to a Series raises a TypeError
test_struct_schema_mismatch: test that appending Series with mismatching struct schemas raises a SchemaError
test_append_null_series: test appending a Null-type Series to an Int64 Series and verify null coercion to Int64
test_append_mismatching_struct_with_null: test that appending Series with different struct field names raises SchemaError
test_extend_struct_schema_mismatch: test that extending a Series with mismatching struct schema raises SchemaError
test_append_enum: test writing and scanning a CSV with an Enum schema and sinking to parquet
